title: Forge, market and gear
summary: How grades work, what the forge can do (upgrade, grade climb, reforge), and how the market prices gear.

blocks.text: Gear has a grade , written as a rank letter, rolled when it drops: F Trash, E Common, D Uncommon, C Rare, B Epic, A Legendary, S Mythic. Above them: EX (Limited editions, never in the shops) and SP (exclusive rewards between S and EX). An account can own several copies of an EX or SP item; only the profile that earned a copy can trade, sell or auction it. A better grade multiplies the stats and the value of the item.

blocks.text: The forge is in the Awakened Plaza. It does three things, and none of them can destroy your item :
blocks.html: The forge is in the Awakened Plaza. It does three things, and none of them can destroy your item:

blocks.text: Upgrade (+1, +2...) : each level adds 8% to the main stats. Max +10 , +25 for an S-grade weapon, +30 for EX and SP weapons. It never fails. Grade climb (at +10): the item goes up one grade (up to S), its forge level goes back to +0 and it gains new bonuses. Reforge : rerolls the bonus stats of the item ( reforge table ). It is the only random part.
blocks.html:
• Upgrade (+1, +2...): each level adds 8% to the main stats. Max +10, +25 for an S-grade weapon, +30 for EX and SP weapons. It never fails.
  • Grade climb (at +10): the item goes up one grade (up to S), its forge level goes back to +0 and it gains new bonuses.
  • Reforge: rerolls the bonus stats of the item (reforge table). It is the only random part.

blocks.text: The market sells potions and gear of your rank . Its stock changes every hour and is the same for every awakened of your rank: each model is mostly Uncommon (D), sometimes Common, Rare or Epic, rarely Legendary. Models of a higher rank, the Nation weapons and the exclusive editions are never sold. Buying costs 4 times the rank E value of the item, times a factor of your rank (from ×1 at rank E to ×30 at Nation, ×130 for a weapon); selling gives back 80% of what you paid (or of its value for a looted item), plus 80% of the shards you put into it at the forge. See Economy formulas and the market stock table .
